Summary: Confirms the delivery scope is stable enough for downstream QA, training, and release work.
EntryCriteria: Implementation is materially complete and release-sensitive downstream work is starting.
ExitCriteria: Scope change after this point is either rejected or explicitly re-opened with re-planning.
Checks: Release-candidate scope is named and versioned.
Late additions are either rejected or explicitly accepted with impact review.
QA, training, and release owners were informed of the frozen scope baseline.
Open defects and known exclusions are captured.
